thought.text: `bcrypt match: true` — the documented admin password works. Let me fix my script's string bug and get the rest:

reasoning_content: "bcrypt match: true" — the admin password `Aa12345678` has been verified! The script had a small string-conversion bug. Let's fix the script.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && cat > /tmp/check_admin.rb <<'RUBY'
require "bcrypt"
u = User.find_by(email: "admin@consul.dev")
puts "bcrypt match: #{BCrypt::Password.new(u.encrypted_password).is_password?("Aa12345678")}"
puts "confirmed: #{!u.confirmed_at.nil?}"
puts "administrator: #{u.administrator ? 'yes' : 'no'}"
counts = %w[mod@consul.dev manager@consul.dev valuator@consul.dev verified@consul.dev unverified@consul.dev].map { |e| "#{e.split('@').first}=" + User.where(email: e).count.to_s }
puts "role users: #{counts.join(', ')}"
RUBY
timeout 200 bin/rails runner /tmp/check_admin.rb 2>&1 | tail -5
